arabic_html:
۞ قَوْلٌۭ مَّعْرُوفٌۭ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ خَيْرٌۭ مِّن صَدَقَةٍۢ يَتْبَعُهَآ أَذًۭى ۗ
وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَلِيمٌۭ ۞
translation: Kind speech and forgiveness are better than charity followed by injury. And Allah is Free of need and Forbearing.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: reminding someone of what you gave them, in words or in manner, causes harm — and that harm annuls the charity. Better to say something kind and give nothing.
